place_fields.summary: A scenic hilltop viewpoint near Magod Falls with broad views across the valley and surrounding Western Ghats.

planning_attributes.description: Jenukallu Gudda, also known as Honey Stone Hill, is a picturesque viewpoint near Yellapur and Magod Falls.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reached from the Yellapur/Magod Falls area; the final approach includes an off-road section.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The approach road can be broken in places; take care when returning after sunset.
planning_attributes.notes: Visitors report limited network connectivity and limited amenities at the viewpoint.

place_fields.vibe: Forested hill trek with panoramic views of Karwar and the coast
place_fields.summary: A long hill trek through forest and rocky terrain leading to a summit with views of Karwar and the seashore.

planning_attributes.description: Guddehalli Gudda is a trekking destination reached by a long trail through forest and rocky terrain to a summit viewpoint.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The trek starts from the Karwar area and continues through Guddehalli village to the summit.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Carry water; steep or muddy sections can become slippery in rain, and visitors are advised not to trek after sunset because of wildlife risk.
planning_attributes.notes: A local guide is recommended because dense forest can make navigation difficult.

place_fields.vibe: Quiet valley viewpoint surrounded by green mountains and forest
place_fields.summary: A hilltop viewpoint overlooking the Kali River in a deep gorge and the surrounding forested hills.

planning_attributes.description: Sykes Kanive Viewpoint, also called Sykes Point, overlooks the Kali River valley near Ambikanagar.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The viewpoint is named after British engineer William Robert Sykes.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Accessible by road to the viewpoint area, followed by a short walk.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Prior permission from Karnataka Power Corporation/KPCL is required for access; photography is restricted on the premises.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Carry identification for the checkpost and follow access instructions because the site is within a restricted power-project area.
planning_attributes.notes: The viewpoint is associated with views of the Kali and Nagzari river area.
